properties.name: app.jwt.secret
properties.description: JWT signing secret key. Use a long random string in production.

properties.name: app.jwt.expiration-ms
properties.description: JWT token expiration time in milliseconds. Default: 86400000 (24 hours).

properties.name: app.email.from-address
properties.description: Sender email address for outgoing email alerts.

properties.name: app.email.from-name
properties.description: Display name used as the sender for outgoing email alerts.

properties.name: app.email.alert-recipient-roles
properties.description: Comma-separated list of user roles that receive email alerts. Available: Admin, Pharmacist, Staff, Supplier.
